span.p: Is any of these true for your workload?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: 5. Team lacks ops maturity for single critical machine?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Single failure = total data loss risk
Requires: backups, replication, failover, capacity mgmt
If team cannot manage this for one machine, one machine
is too risky. Distributed = smaller blast radius

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
│ If ANY of 1, 2, or 5 is YES: Do NOT use vertical scaling │
│ If ONLY 3 or 4 is YES: Vertical scaling is still viable │
│ with additional investment (blue-green, per-tenant isolation) │

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: 4. Data is naturally partitioned by tenant/region?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Multi-tenant SaaS: each tenant's data independent
Separate DB per tenant = better isolation + per-tenant
scaling. Single large instance = noisy neighbor risk
RESULT: Horizontal per-tenant architecture preferred

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
99.99% = 4.38 minutes downtime per month
Instance upgrade stop-start: 2-5 minutes
Blue-green cutover: 30-60 seconds
RESULT: Possible with blue-green, but adds complexity

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Normal: 1,000 req/s Peak: 50,000 req/s
Single machine cannot handle 50x variance efficiently
RESULT: Horizontal auto-scaling, not vertical scaling

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: 1. Growth exceeds largest instance within 12 months?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Working set: 200 GB today, growing 30 GB/month
Largest instance: 256 GB r7g.8xlarge
Months until ceiling: (256 - 200) / 30 = 1.87 months
RESULT: DO NOT VERTICAL SCALE — start horizontal now
